_readme: Curated 'basics' catalog: mainstream giftable PRODUCTS (Apple lineup, Sony audio,
Owala bottles, staple sneakers) + gift-able SERVICES (streaming/membership years).
Ingested by ingest-catalog.mjs -> S3 Vectors (key = id) + DynamoDB posts (/seed).
giftType: 'product' | 'service' — flows through vectors metadata, posts, the
challenge deck, and the iOS taste profile (product-vs-service affinity).
Prices are indicative list prices (Jan 2026 knowledge) — the PA-API enrich step
(paapi-enrich.mjs pattern) is the source of truth once Associates is approved.
Links are stable search/landing URLs on purpose: NO guessed ASINs. Backend agent:
and fill imageUrl from PA-API Images.Primary.Large (the ONLY compliant Amazon
image source). Until then items embed TEXT-ONLY and clients render the branded
gradient fallback card; imageQuery documents what the image should show.
Services carry serviceDuration + category 'services' (the challenge-deck mixer
and byCategory GSI hook). Service landing pages verified-stable paths; re-check
